sections.text: Each employee who has passed probation receives an annual learning allowance of $2,000 per calendar year for courses, conferences, books, and online learning subscriptions. Unused allowance does not carry over to the next year. Employees also receive 3 paid learning days per year that may be used for approved training. Learning allowance purchases are claimed through HR-106 or charged to a corporate card where the employee holds one under FIN-204.

Employees may request up to an additional $1,500 per year for professional certification exam fees when the certification is directly related to their current role. Manager approval must be obtained before registering for the exam. The company pays for a maximum of 2 exam attempts per certification. Certification renewal fees are covered from the annual learning allowance.

Employees with at least 12 months of service may apply for tuition assistance of up to $5,250 per calendar year for accredited degree programs related to the company's business. Applications must be submitted to the People team at least 30 days before the course begins. Assistance is paid after the employee provides proof of a passing grade. Employees who resign within 12 months of receiving tuition assistance or certification funding must repay 100 percent of the amount, and employees who resign between 12 and 24 months must repay 50 percent. Repayment does not apply when employment ends due to redundancy.
